workspace.description: The workspace to list, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

repository.description: The repository, by its full name (owner/name), as list_repositories lists it.

path.description: The folder's path from the repository's root, such as src; the root where left out.

recursive.description: true to list everything under the folder, each entry by its path from the folder; false or left out for the folder's own entries.
